crossRefs.note: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me; and the Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession…
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down…
For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not…
They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment…
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…
Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear…
Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.
Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit…
the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
“Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?
He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and…
If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to…
“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

translations.web: “Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
translations.bsb: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
translations.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
translations.asv: And even now the axe lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
